title: BudgetPix: Compute-Adaptive Tokenization for Pixel-Space Image Diffusion
title_zh: 预算pix: 计算自适应像素空间图像扩散的 tokenization 方法

paragraphs.en: Most image generation models rely on uniform tokenization, allocating the exact same computational budget to equally-sized image patches. This static paradigm cannot adapt to different resource constraints at inference time, and yields suboptimal quality-cost tradeoff by devoting the same effort to both plain backgrounds and intricate details. We propose BudgetPix, an adaptive tokenization framework that dynamically allocates compute based on visual complexity and spatial layout, enabling flexible computational budgeting at inference time. BudgetPix comprises three key components: (1) an adaptive encoder that maps a fixed-size image to a variable-length token sequence using an entropy-guided quadtree alongside a multi-scale patch embedder; (2) a scale-aware decoder reconstructs fixed-resolution images from multi-scale token sets; and (3) a flexible training and sampling schedule that enables pixel-space denoisers to operate across variable token counts. BudgetPix seamlessly integrates with existing pixel-space diffusion architectures, enabling a single checkpoint to be operated at a wide range of compute budgets. Evaluated on text-to-image generation, BudgetPix matches the fidelity of MiniT2I-L at 512 2 512^{2} and PixelDiT at 1024 2 1024^{2} using just 25% of the original compute budget. In class-conditional using a MeanFlow backbone, BudgetPix requires merely 60% of the full compute budget to produce images with near-zero quality degradation, observing a marginal 0.8-point increase in FID. Comprehensive assessments by human and VLM judges confirm that BudgetPix establishes a significantly improved quality-efficiency tradeoff over prior budget-adaptive baselines. More details are available at our project page: https://karaozgur.com/BudgetPix

paragraphs.en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) ( Peebles & Xie, 2023 ) have established a new standard for image generation. While most architectures operate in the latent space of a pretrained autoencoder ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) , emerging pixel-space DiTs ( Li & He, 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) process raw pixels directly, bypassing the reconstruction ceiling and eliminating the reliance on a separate tokenizer. However, this architectural purity introduces a severe computational bottleneck: the uniform tokenization. Because self-attention scales quadratically with the number of tokens, pixel-space models incur massive computational costs. Furthermore, because this grid resolution is hardcoded during training, the inference cost becomes rigidly fixed. A deployed model cannot scale down to accommodate resource-constrained edge devices, nor can it dynamically adjust to varying user latency requirements, without undergoing entirely separate retraining.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散变换器（DiTs）（Peebles & Xie, 2023）为图像生成树立了新的标准。 尽管大多数架构都在预训练自编码器的潜在空间中运行（Rombach et al., 2022），但新兴的像素空间 DiTs（Li & He, 2026；Yu et al., 2026）则直接处理原始像素，从而绕过了重建能力的上限，并消除了对独立分词器的依赖。 然而，这种架构上的纯粹性也带来了一个严重的计算瓶颈：均匀的分词方式。 由于自注意力机制的计算量随令牌数量呈二次方增长，像素空间模型因此产生了巨大的计算成本。 此外，由于这种网格分辨率在训练阶段就被硬编码，推理成本也因此变得固定不变。 部署后的模型既无法通过缩减规模来适应资源受限的边缘设备，也无法动态调整以匹配用户不同的延迟需求，除非进行完全独立的重新训练。

paragraphs.en: This static uniform tokenization is fundamentally misaligned with how visual data is structured. Information density varies significantly within images: a cloudless sky offers minimal visual entropy, while heavily textured objects demand the capture of high-frequency details. Forcing a uniform grid to blindly spend identical compute across both regions creates severe computational waste. As shown in Figure 2 a, standard MiniT2I ( Wang et al., 2026b ) wastes 1,024 tokens rendering a simple flag against an open sky, whereas our content-adaptive framework reconstructs the scene perfectly with just 307 tokens (Figure 2 b). Even for complex, edge-to-edge textures like a jackfruit–which strictly requires 256 tokens in standard JiT ( Li & He, 2026 ) (Figure 2 c)–BudgetPix matches the baseline visual quality while cutting the required token budget by 50% (Figure 2 d).
paragraphs.zh: 这种静态的均匀分词方式与视觉数据的结构从根本上就不匹配。 图像内部的信息密度差异显著：无云的天空几乎不产生视觉熵，而纹理密集的对象则需要捕捉高频细节。 强行让均匀网格在这些区域上盲目地分配相同的计算资源，会造成严重的计算浪费。 如图 2a 所示，标准的 MiniT2I（Wang et al., 2026b）在渲染一面旗帜与开阔天空的场景时浪费了 1,024 个智能体，而我们的内容自适应框架仅用 307 个智能体就完美重建了该场景（图 2b）。 即使对于像菠萝蜜这样复杂且覆盖整个画面边缘的纹理——在标准的 JiT（Li & He, 2026）中严格需要 256 个智能体（图 2c）——BudgetPix 也能在保持与基线模型相同的视觉质量的同时，将所需智能体数量减少 50%（图 2d）。

paragraphs.en: Content-adaptive tokenization is well established in discriminative vision models via token merging ( Bolya et al., 2023 ) , token pruning ( Rao et al., 2021 ) , or dynamic multi-scale representations ( Beyer et al., 2023 ; Dehghani et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Choudhury et al., 2026 ) . However, extending this paradigm to generative models introduces a fundamental challenge. While discriminative models dynamically allocate tokens over an already-provided input image to predict a class label ( Choudhury et al., 2026 ) , generative denoisers must dynamically allocate compute over an image that is actively being generated . This creates a chicken-and-egg dilemma: the denoiser must gauge the local spatial complexity of the image before the image content itself has fully materialized.
paragraphs.zh: 内容自适应的标记化方法在判别式视觉模型中已得到广泛应用，具体方式包括通过标记合并（Bolya 等，2023）、标记剪枝（Rao 等，2021）或动态多尺度表示（Beyer 等，2023；Dehghani 等，2023；Kim 等，2025；Choudhury 等，2026）。 然而，将这一范式扩展到生成式模型则引入了一个根本性的挑战。 尽管判别式模型会在已提供的输入图像上动态分配标记以预测类别标签（Choudhury 等，2026），但生成式去噪器却必须在图像被主动生成的过程中动态分配计算资源。 这造成了一个“鸡与蛋”的困境：在图像内容本身尚未完全形成之前，去噪器就必须评估图像的局部空间复杂度。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we propose BudgetPix, a framework that adapts any pretrained pixel-space diffusion transformer into a compute-adaptive image generator. BudgetPix introduces three novel components. First, an entropy-driven encoder maps images into variable-length sequences of multi-scale tokens. Second, A complementary decoder reconstructs these variable-length token sequences into predetermined, fixed-resolution images. Finally, a training and inference strategy, coupled with content-layout augmentation, enables standard checkpoints–originally trained on fixed token budgets–to become dynamically adjustable during inference. Our extensive experiments (Section 4.3 ) demonstrate that BudgetPix can be integrated seamlessly with established pixel-space architectures–including JiT ( Li & He, 2026 ) , MiniT2I ( Wang et al., 2026b ) , PixelDiT ( Yu et al., 2026 ) , and MeanFlow ( Geng et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) –and provide a significantly-better quality-efficiency tradeoff (see plots in Section 4.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 BudgetPix——一个能够将任何预训练的像素空间扩散变换器适配为计算自适应图像生成器的框架。 BudgetPix 引入了三个创新组件。 首先，一个熵驱动的编码器将图像映射为多尺度标记的变长序列。 其次，一个互补的解码器将这些变长标记序列重构为预定分辨率的固定图像。 最后，一种结合内容布局增强的训练与推理策略，使得原本在固定标记预算上训练的模型检查点在推理过程中能够动态调整。 我们的大量实验（第 4.3 节）表明，BudgetPix 可以与成熟的像素空间架构无缝集成——包括 JiT（Li & He, 2026）、MiniT2I（Wang et al., 2026b）、PixelDiT（Yu et al., 2026）和 MeanFlow（Geng et al., 2026；Lu et al., 2026）——并实现了显著更优的质量与效率权衡（参见第 4.3 节的图表）。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate BudgetPix on class-conditional and text-to-image pixel-space diffusion models from 256 2 256^{2} to 1024 2 1024^{2} resolution. Under strict low-compute budgets where prior budget-adaptive methods undergo catastrophic collapse, BudgetPix degrades gracefully, preserving high perceptual quality. For class-conditional generation, BudgetPix synthesizes coherent, high-quality images using as little as 10% of the original compute budget (Figure 1 , top 3 rows)–a regime where competing methods fail entirely (cf. Figure 6 ). This robustness mirrors phenomena observed in lossy image compression, where visual data can be heavily down-sampled without significant perceptual degradation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在分辨率为 256² 到 1024² 的类别条件图像生成模型和文本到图像的像素空间扩散模型上对 BudgetPix 进行了评估。 在严格的低计算预算条件下，此前基于预算自适应的方法会出现灾难性崩溃，而 BudgetPix 却能优雅地降级，同时保持较高的感知质量。 对于类别条件生成，BudgetPix 仅需使用原始计算预算的 10% 即可合成连贯的高质量图像（图 1 顶部三行）——在这一预算水平下，其他竞争方法则完全失效（参见图 6）。 这种鲁棒性类似于有损图像压缩中观察到的现象：视觉数据可以被大幅降采样，而不会导致明显的感知质量下降。

paragraphs.en: We propose BudgetPix, a novel compute-adaptive tokenization framework for pixel-space image diffusion, designed to integrate smoothly into diverse pixel-based diffusion architectures such as JiT, MiniT2I, PixelDiT, and MeanFlow.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 BudgetPix，这是一种面向像素空间图像扩散的新型计算自适应分词框架，旨在与 JiT、MiniT2I、PixelDiT 和 MeanFlow 等多样化的基于像素的扩散架构无缝集成。

paragraphs.en: BudgetPix introduces three novel components: (1) an entropy-based encoder mapping images into variable-length sequences of multi-scale tokens; (2) a specialized decoder reconstructing fixed-resolution images from these tokens; and (3) a flexible training and sampling schedule supporting denoisers to operate across continuously variable token counts.
paragraphs.zh: BudgetPix 引入了三种创新组件：(1) 一种基于熵的编码器，可将图像映射为多尺度标记的变长序列；(2) 一种专用解码器，可从这些标记中重建固定分辨率的图像；以及 (3) 一种灵活的训练和采样方案，支持去噪器在连续变化的标记数量范围内运行。

paragraphs.en: Comprehensive experiments show that BudgetPix achieves an effective quality-efficiency tradeoff compared with alternative adaptive denoising methods.
paragraphs.zh: 全面的实验表明，与其他的自适应去噪方法相比，BudgetPix 实现了有效的质量-效率权衡。

paragraphs.en: For several years the cost of resolution was handled by not paying it: latent diffusion generates inside a pretrained autoencoder ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) , at the price of a reconstruction ceiling and a second training stage. To manage this, early pixel-space models relied on U-Nets that omitted attention except at the lowest resolutions, before advancing to cascaded models ( Ho et al., 2022 ) , single models with resolution-shifting noise schedules ( Hoogeboom et al., 2023 ; Hoogeboom et al., 2025 ) , and finally, hierarchical transformers ( Crowson et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . The most recent line drops the hierarchy altogether: JiT ( Li & He, 2026 ) and PixelDiT ( Yu et al., 2026 ) denoise large patches with a plain transformer and a narrow patch embedding, matching latent-model quality at the same sequence length. While this approach offers simplicity, it relies on a single uniform patch grid where size rigidly fixes the computational cost of every step. It also introduces a known weakness in decoding large patches, which PixelDiT addresses with a second pixel-level stage and PixNerd resolves with a per-patch neural field ( Wang et al., 2026a ) . We adapt a released model of exactly same architecture with AdaLN conditioning ( Peebles & Xie, 2023 ) trained via flow matching ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) settings and classifier-free guidance ( Ho & Salimans, 2021 ) utilized during inference .
paragraphs.zh: 多年来，解决这一问题的代价是选择不去支付它：潜在扩散模型在预训练自编码器内部生成内容（Rombach 等人，2022），但为此付出了重建质量上限和第二阶段训练的代价。 为了应对这一问题，早期的像素空间模型依赖 U-Net 网络，仅在最低分辨率时启用注意力机制；随后发展为级联模型（Ho 等人，2022）、具有分辨率偏移噪声调度的单一模型（Hoogeboom 等人，2023；Hoogeboom 等人，2025），最终演变为分层 Transformer（Crowson 等人，2024；Chen 等人，2025）。 最新的方法完全摒弃了分层结构：JiT（Li & He，2026）和 PixelDiT（Yu 等人，2026）使用普通 Transformer 和窄带块嵌入对大块区域进行去噪，在相同序列长度下达到了潜在模型的质量水平。 尽管这种方法具有简洁性，但它依赖单一的均匀块网格，其中块的大小会刚性地决定每一步的计算成本。 这种方法还在解码大块区域时引入了一个已知弱点；PixelDiT 通过第二个像素级阶段解决了这一问题，而 PixNerd 则通过每个块独立的神经场实现了这一目标（Wang 等人，2026a）。 我们采用了一个架构完全相同的已发布模型，该模型使用了 AdaLN 条件输入（Peebles & Xie，2023），并通过流匹配（Lipman 等人，2023）进行训练，在推理阶段还应用了无分类器引导（Ho & Salimans，2021）。

paragraphs.en: Non-uniform, layout-based token reduction first emerged for discriminative vision tasks within pretrained transformers ( Bolya et al., 2023 ; Rao et al., 2021 ; Liang et al., 2022 ; Yin et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2021 ) , and later as tokenization proper, through flexible patch sizes and content-following tokenizers ( Beyer et al., 2023 ; Dehghani et al., 2023 ; Lew et al., 2024 ; Ronen et al., 2023 ; Havtorn et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2025 ) . Adapting such strategies remains difficult for generation, because a denoiser must write an image through the layout and no image exists when the layout is chosen. Adaptive work here has therefore stayed off the input grid, varying what is updated or cached along the trajectory ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Bolya & Hoffman, 2023 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Zou et al., 2025 ) , varying patch size uniformly over the image ( Anagnostidis et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , or retraining a latent tokenizer ( Shen et al., 2026 ) . Concurrent with us, RTI ( Zamfir et al., 2026 ) adapts a frozen pixel-space model using LoRA to consume region tokens. In contrast, our method, BudgetPix, plugs in our adaptive encoder and decoder, fully fine-tunes the entire checkpoint to accept variable-sized inputs starting from the first block, and derives the layout from the model’s own estimate of the clean image rather than its internal features.
paragraphs.zh: 非均匀、基于布局的标记缩减最初出现在预训练Transformer中的判别性视觉任务中（Bolya等，2023；Rao等，2021；Liang等，2022；Yin等，2022；Wang等，2021），后来则发展为真正的标记化方法，通过灵活的块大小和跟随内容变化的标记化器实现（Beyer等，2023；Dehghani等，2023；Lew等，2024；Ronen等，2023；Havtorn等，2023；Kim等，2025）。 将此类策略应用于生成任务仍然具有挑战性，因为去噪器必须通过布局来绘制图像，而选择布局时并不存在实际的图像。 因此，此领域的自适应研究一直集中在输入网格之外，通过改变轨迹中更新或缓存的内容（Liu等，2026；Bolya与Hoffman，2023；Wu等，2025；Zou等，2025）、在图像上均匀调整块大小（Anagnostidis等，2025；Li等，2026），或重新训练潜在标记化器（Shen等，2026）来实现。 与我们同时，RTI（Zamfir等，2026）使用LoRA对冻结的像素空间模型进行适配，以消耗区域标记。 相比之下，我们的方法BudgetPix插入了自适应编码器和解码器，对整个检查点进行了完全微调，使其从第一个块开始就能接受可变尺寸的输入，并且布局是从模型自身对干净图像的估计中推导出来的，而非其内部特征。

paragraphs.en: BudgetPix is designed to adapt existing pixel-space diffusion transformers into compute-adaptive image generators. As shown in Figure 3 , it consists of three core components: an encoder that compresses images into variable-length, multi-scale token sequences (Sec. 3.2 ), a complementary decoder that reconstructs these token sequences back to fixed-resolution images (Sec. 3.3 ), and a unified training and inference strategy (Sec. 3.4 ). By replacing the uniform tokenization of standard baselines with this content-adaptive pipeline, BudgetPix enables existing diffusion backbones to seamlessly process flexible token counts and adjust their computational budget based on visual complexity.
paragraphs.zh: BudgetPix 旨在将现有的像素空间扩散变换器转化为可自适应计算资源需求的图像生成器。 如图 3 所示，它由三个核心组件构成：一个将图像压缩为可变长度、多尺度标记序列的编码器（第 3.2 节）、一个将这些标记序列重构为固定分辨率图像的互补解码器（第 3.3 节），以及一种统一的训练与推理策略（第 3.4 节）。 通过用这种内容自适应流程取代标准基线模型中的均匀标记化方式，BudgetPix 使现有的扩散模型主干能够无缝处理灵活的标记数量，并根据视觉复杂度调整其计算资源预算。

paragraphs.en: Non-Uniform Layout Construction: The image layout determines the spatial partition of the image–specifically, which regions maintain the base p × p p\!\times\!p patch resolution and which are merged into larger patches to be encoded as a single token. Because visual complexity is spatially non-uniform, fine details concentrate on specific regions while homogeneous areas ( e.g. , sky or a plain wall) contain minimal information. Inspired by APT ( Choudhury et al., 2026 ) , we construct this non-uniform layout based on local intensity entropy. The layout is computed from the image during both training and inference. During training, it is derived directly from the ground-truth image x x . At inference, because the clean image is unavailable, the model initially runs a few warm-up denoising steps on a uniform p × p p\times p grid to generate a predicted image x ^ \hat{x} , which is then used to estimate the content-adaptive layout.
paragraphs.zh: 非均匀布局构建：图像布局决定了图像的空间划分——具体而言，哪些区域保持基础的 p × p 块分辨率，哪些区域被合并为更大的块以编码为单个标记。 由于视觉复杂度的空间分布并不均匀，精细细节集中在特定区域，而均匀区域（例如天空或纯色墙壁）包含的信息极少。 受 APT（Choudhury 等人，2026）启发，我们基于局部强度熵来构建这种非均匀布局。 该布局在训练和推理阶段均从图像中计算得出。 在训练阶段，它直接从真实图像 x 中推导得出。 在推理阶段，由于无法获取原始清晰图像，模型会先在一个均匀的 p × p 网格上运行若干次预热去噪步骤以生成预测图像 x ^，然后利用该图像来估计内容自适应的布局。

paragraphs.en: Layout Augmentation: To ensure the transformer can reliably process sequences of varying lengths, we dynamically assign one of three distinct layout types to each image during training. Let Q ⁡ ( ⋅ , τ + δ ) Q(\cdot,\tau+\delta) represent the entropy quadtree defined by thresholds τ s + δ \tau_{s}+\delta , and let H ⁡ ( x ) H(x) denote the true entropy map of the training image x x . Uniform layout (probability a < 1 a<1 ): The model uses L uniform L_{\mathrm{uniform}} , the standard dense grid of the base architecture. This anchors the training process and prevents catastrophic drift from the pretrained weights. Random layout (probability b b , where a + b < 1 a+b<1 ): The quadtree Q ⁡ ( H ~ , τ + δ ) Q(\tilde{H},\tau+\delta) is applied to a synthetic entropy map H ~ \tilde{H} , where values are drawn uniformly between 0 0 and log 2 ⁡ K \log_{2}K bits per cell. Crucially, this forces coarse tokens to randomly encompass highly detailed image regions. This simulates the constraints of low-budget inference, preventing the model from assuming that coarse tokens only represent flat backgrounds. Content-adaptive layout (probability 1 − a − b 1-a-b ): The standard quadtree Q ⁡ ( H ⁡ ( x ) , τ + δ ) Q(H(x),\tau+\delta) is applied using the actual image entropy map, optimally routing tokens based on true visual complexity. For both the random and content-adaptive quadtree layouts, the global offset δ \delta is randomly sampled for each training image. This ensures the model learns to operate across a continuous range of token counts, scaling from roughly 25% up to 100% of the original dense grid.
paragraphs.zh: 布局增强：为确保变换器能够可靠地处理不同长度的序列，我们在训练期间为每张图像动态分配三种不同布局类型之一。 令 Q ⁡ ( ⋅ , τ + δ ) Q(\cdot,\tau+\delta) 表示由阈值 τ s + δ \tau_{s}+\delta 定义的熵四叉树，并令 H ⁡ ( x ) H(x) 表示训练图像 x x 的真实熵图。 均匀布局（概率 a < 1 a<1）：模型使用 L uniform L_{\mathrm{uniform}}，即基础架构的标准密集网格。 这为训练过程提供了锚点，并防止了预训练权重发生灾难性漂移。 随机布局（概率 b b，其中 a + b < 1 a+b<1）：将四叉树 Q ⁡ ( H ~ , τ + δ ) Q(\tilde{H},\tau+\delta) 应用于合成熵图 H ~ \tilde{H}，其中数值在 0 0 和 log 2 ⁡ K \log_{2}K 比特/单元之间均匀采样。 关键在于，这迫使粗粒度标记随机覆盖图像中高度细节的区域。 这模拟了低预算推理的约束条件，防止模型假设粗粒度标记仅表示平坦的背景。 内容自适应布局（概率 1 − a − b 1-a-b）：使用真实的图像熵图应用标准四叉树 Q ⁡ ( H ⁡ ( x ) , τ + δ ) Q(H(x),\tau+\delta)，根据真实视觉复杂度优化标记的路由。 对于随机和自适应内容布局的四叉树，全局偏移量 δ \delta 在每张训练图像上均随机采样。 这确保了模型能够学习在连续范围的标记数量下运行，其规模从原始密集网格的大约 25% 扩展至 100%。

paragraphs.en: Sampling with Dynamic Layout Estimation: During inference, the image’s entropy is unknown before it is generated, so the layout is estimated as the image forms. Let i i index the sampling steps and x ^ i \hat{x}_{i} be the model’s prediction of the clean image at step i i . The first n w n_{w} warm-up steps run on the uniform grid, L i = L uniform L_{i}=L_{\mathrm{uniform}} , which lets the model set the global composition of the image. After that, the layout is the entropy quadtree of the current prediction, L i = Q ⁡ ( H ⁡ ( x ^ i ′ ) , τ + δ ∗ ​ ( x ^ i ′ , B ) ) L_{i}=Q\big(H(\hat{x}_{i^{\prime}}),\tau+\delta^{*}(\hat{x}_{i^{\prime}},B)\big) , with the thresholds shifted by the offset δ ∗ \delta^{*} that budget mode finds for this prediction and the budget B B . The layout is rebuilt only every m m steps: i ′ = n w + m ⁡ ⌊ ( i − n w ) / m ⌋ i^{\prime}=n_{w}+m\lfloor(i-n_{w})/m\rfloor is the last rebuild step at or before i i , so the m m steps from i ′ i^{\prime} on share one layout.
paragraphs.zh: 基于动态布局估计的采样：在推理过程中，图像生成前其熵值是未知的，因此会在图像逐步生成的同时对其布局进行估计。 令 i 表示采样步骤，x ^ i 为模型在第 i 步对干净图像的预测结果。 最初 n w 个预热步骤在均匀网格上运行，L i = L uniform ，这使得模型能够确定图像的整体构图。 此后，布局即为当前预测结果的熵四叉树，L i = Q ⁡ ( H ⁡ ( x ^ i ′ ) , τ + δ ∗ ​ ( x ^ i ′ , B ) ) ，其中阈值由偏移量 δ ∗ 调整，该偏移量是预算模式针对此预测和预算 B 所确定的值。 布局仅每隔 m 步重建一次：i ′ = n w + m ⁡ ⌊ ( i − n w ) / m ⌋ 表示在 i 步或之前最近的重建步骤，因此从 i ′ 开始的 m 步将共享同一个布局。

Each is fine-tuned once with the layout augmentation (with a = 0.15 a=0.15 , b = 0.1 b=0.1 ) using the objective described in Section 3.4 . The added modules are zero-initialized, so training starts exactly from the released model (see App. C.2 – C.4 ).

paragraphs.en: We compare BudgetPix against the released checkpoints driven to the same budget through our sampler and three token-reduction methods on those weights. The three token-reduction baselines are: (i) ToMe ( Bolya et al., 2023 ) , the feature-similarity merge of ToMeSD ( Bolya & Hoffman, 2023 ) applied once, (ii) down to the budget ( Bolya & Hoffman, 2023 ) ( FeatSim ), and (iii) RTI ( Zamfir et al., 2026 ) , a concurrent adapter with region tokens, run from its released checkpoint. Every method shares prompts or labels, initial noise, solver, step count and attention arithmetic; only the budget and the reduction rule differ. See App. C.5 for the protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 BudgetPix 与我们采样器以及针对这些权重的三种标记减少方法所生成的、达到相同预算的已发布检查点进行比较。 这三种标记减少基线分别是：(i) ToMe（Bolya 等人，2023），即对 ToMeSD（Bolya 和 Hoffman，2023）的特征相似性合并进行一次应用；(ii) down to the budget（Bolya 和 Hoffman，2023）（FeatSim）；以及 (iii) RTI（Zamfir 等人，2026），一种使用区域标记的并行适配器，其运行基于已发布的检查点。 所有方法共享提示或标签、初始噪声、求解器、步数以及注意力运算；唯一不同的是预算和减少规则。相关协议请参见附录 C.5。

paragraphs.en: We use FID-50k ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) and Inception score ( Salimans et al., 2016 ) for class-conditional quality, GenEval ( Ghosh et al., 2023 ) and DPG-Bench ( Hu et al., 2024 ) for prompt adherence, and CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , PickScore ( Kirstain et al., 2023 ) and ImageReward ( Xu et al., 2023 ) for preference on PartiPrompts ( Yu et al., 2022 ) . We additionally measure faithfulness, whether a reduced-budget output preserves the same image , using paired PSNR, SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) , CLIP and DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) similarity against each method’s own output at full 100% budget. Cost is measured by wall-clock time; see App. C.7 for details.

paragraphs.en: We measure faithfulness, that is, how much a method’s image at a reduced budget similar to the image the same method produces at their full budget. In Figure 7 (b), ours stays closest to its dense image on nearly every metric and budget, while the base model and both baselines significantly diverge from the original image at 70% budget. These gaps can be attributed to the fact that our layout merges the flattest regions first and the refiner restores their texture, whereas the merging baselines group tokens by feature similarity across the whole frame and the base model receives coarse tokens it was never trained on. See App. B.2 for the base model and ours on JiT.
paragraphs.zh: 我们衡量了保真度，即某种方法在较低预算下生成的图像与其在全预算下生成的图像有多相似。在图 7(b) 中，我们的方法在几乎每个指标和预算水平上都与原始密集图像最为接近，而基础模型和两种基线模型在 70% 预算下便与原始图像显著偏离。这些差异可以归因于以下事实：我们的布局首先合并最平坦的区域，再由细化器恢复其纹理；而合并类基线模型则根据整个画面中特征相似性对标记进行分组，基础模型接收到的则是它从未训练过的粗略标记。关于基础模型和我们在 JiT 上的表现，请参见附录 B.2。

paragraphs.en: The paired metrics say how far an image moved, not when a reader would notice. In a user study (Figure 9 ), 50 people per form compare images on 20 GenEval prompts, and in VLM-as-Judge a vision–language model does the same on 100. Shown a method’s own dense image and a grid of its budgets, the budget can be cut by 52 % for ours before human raters first see a difference, against at most 38 % for the baselines, and by 36 % against at most 21 % before the VLM judge does (Figure 9 a). When shown the full-budget image and two budget-reduced candidates from two different methods, human raters find ours more faithful than RTI at all four budgets considered. The VLM judge also favors ours than every baseline below 80 % (Figure 9 b). See App. C.6 for both protocols.
paragraphs.zh: 成对指标说明了图像移动的距离，而非读者何时会注意到这种变化。 在一项用户研究中（图 9），每份表格有 50 人比较 20 个 GenEval 提示下的图像；而在“VLM 作为评判者”方案中，一个视觉-语言模型则对 100 个提示执行了同样的操作。 当展示某方法自身的密集图像及其预算的网格时，我们的方法在人类评分者首次察觉差异前，其预算最多可削减 52%，而基线方法最多只能削减 38%；在 VLM 评判者察觉差异前，我们的方法可削减 36%，而基线方法最多只能削减 21%（图 9a）。 当展示全预算图像以及两种不同方法生成的两个预算削减候选图像时，人类评分者在所有四个考虑的预算水平下，都认为我们的方法比 RTI 更具保真度。 VLM 评判者也在低于 80% 的所有预算水平上更青睐我们的方法，而非任何基线方法（图 9b）。有关两种协议的详细信息，请参见附录 C.6。

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 (a) plots every text-to-image metric against the measured wall-clock speed-up over the full budget inference time. BudgetPix maintains its scores across all five metrics and on the whole speed-up range, the base model starts at the same value but collapses fast. The merging baselines buy less speed, since the merge itself costs time. See App. B.4 for the other base models.
paragraphs.zh: 图 7(a) 将每一项文本到图像指标与在整个预算推理时间内测得的实际加速效果进行了对比。BudgetPix 在所有五项指标上均保持了稳定的得分，并且在整个加速范围内表现一致；而基础模型虽然初始值相同，但其性能迅速下降。合并基线方法带来的加速效果较弱，因为合并过程本身也需要时间。其他基础模型的结果请参见附录 B.4。

paragraphs.en: BudgetPix reduces the cost per step, rather than the number of steps, making it complementary to inference-efficiency methods such as distillation. We note that BudgetPix is still applicable to one-step generation methods by using the random layout (described in sec 3.4 ) instead of the layout from the warm-up steps. Figure 10 shows our results on one-step (1-NFE) pixel MeanFlow (pMF-L/16; Lu et al., 2026 ), fine-tuned on layouts from training images of each class. While the released model’s weights collapse at 80 %; BudgetPix maintains FID below 4 down at 50% budget (see App. B.6 and A.5 for more results).
paragraphs.zh: BudgetPix 降低的是每一步的成本，而非步骤数量，因此它与蒸馏等推理效率提升方法具有互补性。我们注意到，通过使用随机布局（见第 3.4 节）而非预热步骤中的布局，BudgetPix 仍然适用于单步生成方法。图 10 展示了我们在单步（1-NFE）像素 MeanFlow（pMF-L/16；Lu et al., 2026）上的实验结果，该模型已针对每个类别训练图像中的布局进行了微调。尽管已发布的模型在预算降至 80% 时其权重会崩溃，但 BudgetPix 在预算降至 50% 时仍能保持 FID 低于 4（更多结果请参见附录 B.6 和 A.5）。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 provides the ablation study of BudgetPix components. The aggregator does most of the work, since it helps coarse tokens carry their region’s content. The refiner takes roughly a further third off, and its contribution grows as the budget falls, since it acts only inside coarse regions. See App. D for other ablations and App. D.6 for the entropy quadtree against random and oracle layouts.
paragraphs.zh: 表 2 提供了 BudgetPix 各组件的消融研究。聚合器承担了大部分工作，因为它能帮助粗粒度标记承载其所在区域的内容。精炼器进一步减少了约三分之一的开销，且随着预算降低，其贡献度会相应增加，因为它仅在粗粒度区域内发挥作用。其他消融研究请参见附录 D，而熵四叉树与随机布局和理想布局的对比则请参见附录 D.6。

paragraphs.en: BudgetPix shows that a pretrained pixel-space diffusion transformer’s token count does not need to remain fixed to its pretraining configuration. After one fine-tuning, a single checkpoint serves budgets spanning from a dense grid to a small fraction of it and degrades gracefully where token-merging baselines collapse, even at 1 NFE (Figure 10 ). Its limitations are that the layout is derived from the model’s intermediate predictions, so it can miss details they do not yet show, and that full-resolution stages, such as PixelDiT’s pixel stage, cap the speed-up. Learning where to place tokens, not deriving it from entropy, is a natural next step.
paragraphs.zh: BudgetPix 表明，预训练像素空间扩散变换器的令牌数量不必固定在其预训练配置上。 经过一次微调后，单个检查点即可支持从密集网格到其一小部分的预算范围，并且在令牌合并基线崩溃时（即使在 1 NFE 的情况下），性能也能平滑下降（图 10）。 其局限性在于，布局源自模型的中间预测，因此可能会遗漏这些预测尚未显示的细节；此外，全分辨率阶段（例如 PixelDiT 的像素阶段）会限制加速效果。 学习如何放置令牌，而不是从熵中推导出来，是一个自然的下一步。

paragraphs.en: In budget mode δ \delta is bisected so that every image gets at most the requested token count; in threshold mode δ \delta is fixed and each image takes the count its content gives. Threshold mode sweeps δ \delta from − 1 -1 to + 4 +4 on JiT-L/32 at 512 2 512^{2} , with the images, noise and protocol of Table 3 ; budget mode is that table’s points, with 40, 30, 20 and 10 % added. Figure 37 draws both down to a fifth of the grid, with bars of one standard deviation of the token count across images, and Table 14 lists every point. Read at the same mean token count the two modes lie on nearly one curve. What threshold mode gives up is the per-image guarantee, which is why every other number in the paper is in budget mode; see App. D.9 for a pooled budget. Figure 38 shows the layout as the budget falls for a penguin before a plain wall (top) and a textured toyshop (bottom).
paragraphs.zh: 在预算模式下，δ 会被二等分，以确保每张图像的令牌数量最多不超过请求的数量；而在阈值模式下，δ 是固定的，每张图像会取其内容所对应的令牌数量。 在阈值模式下，δ 在 JiT-L/32 上从 -1 到 +4 的范围进行扫描，分辨率为 512²，并使用表 3 中的图像、噪声和协议；预算模式则采用该表中的各数据点，并额外增加 40%、30%、20% 和 10%。 图 37 将两者均绘制到网格的五分之一区域，其中条形图表示跨图像的令牌数量的一个标准差，而表 14 列出了所有数据点。 在相同的平均令牌数量下读取时，这两种模式几乎位于同一条曲线上。 阈值模式所放弃的是每张图像的保证，这也是论文中其他所有数据都采用预算模式的原因；有关合并预算的说明，请参见附录 D.9。 图 38 展示了当预算减少时，企鹅在纯色墙壁（顶部）和带有纹理的玩具店（底部）背景前的布局。

paragraphs.en: Tables 18 and 19 give each parent’s fine-tuning recipe, read from its run, and the sampler behind its benchmark scores. Every parent starts from its released checkpoint (for JiT, its EMA weights), all weights are fine-tuned, and one checkpoint per parent serves every budget. MiniT2I-L’s 120K mix is BLIP3o-60k (58,859 images), DALL-E 3 (19,016) and ShareGPT-4o-Image (41,355), with 1,024 held out. paragraphs.zh: 表18和表19分别列出了每个父模型从其运行中读取的微调方案，以及其基准分数所采用的采样器。每个父模型都从其发布的检查点（对于JiT而言，则是其EMA权重）开始，所有权重均经过微调，且每个父模型使用一个检查点为每种预算服务。MiniT2I-L的120K混合数据集包含BLIP3o-60k（58,859张图像）、DALL-E 3（19,016张）和ShareGPT-4o-Image（41,355张），另有1,024张图像被预留。预留数据的FID评估使用了50步（参见附录C.5），而实际运行时间则遵循表21中的设置。

paragraphs.en: Layout: the entropy quadtree on a 512-bin luma histogram (entropy in [ 0 , 9 ] [0,9] bits), with τ 2 ​ p = 6.0 \tau_{2p}=6.0 and τ 4 ​ p = 4.0 \tau_{4p}=4.0 bits; the offset δ ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( 0 , 2 ) \delta\sim\mathcal{U}(0,2) is drawn per image and step; a = 0.15 a=0.15 of the images train on the dense grid, and b = 0.10 b=0.10 of the rest (8.5 % of all images) on the random layout, whose cell entropies are drawn uniformly in [ 0 , 9 ] [0,9] bits (Section 3.4 ). No image augmentation: a centre crop and a resize fix the geometry. Optimisation: AdamW without weight decay, a linear warm-up then a constant learning rate, the added modules at 8 × 8\times the backbone rate, EMA 0.9999 in fp32 (the evaluated weights), bf16 autocast with fp32 master weights, seed 0, four GPUs. Sampling: the first n w n_{w} steps run on the dense grid, and the layout is recomputed every m = 5 m=5 steps.
paragraphs.zh: 布局：基于 512 个分箱的亮度直方图的熵四叉树（熵值范围 [0,9] 比特），其中 τ₂ₚ = 6.0 比特，τ₄ₚ = 4.0 比特；偏移量 δ ∼ 𝒰(0,2) 按每张图像和每个步骤抽取；a = 0.15 的图像在密集网格上训练，其余 b = 0.10 的图像（占所有图像的 8.5%）则在随机布局上训练，其单元熵值在 [0,9] 比特范围内均匀抽取（第 3.4 节）。 无图像增强：中心裁剪和缩放可固定几何结构。 优化：使用 AdamW 优化器且无权重衰减，先进行线性预热，随后采用恒定学习率；附加模块的学习率为主干网络的 8 倍；在 fp32 模式下使用 EMA 0.9999（评估所用权重），结合 bf16 自动类型转换与 fp32 主权重，随机种子为 0，使用四块 GPU。 采样：前 n_w 个步骤在密集网格上运行，布局每 m = 5 步重新计算一次。

paragraphs.en: pMF-L/16 (see App. B.6 ) is fine-tuned with pMF’s own objective, ported from its code (the MeanFlow identity with its forward-mode derivative, x x -prediction with the guidance in the target, the auxiliary v v -loss, and LPIPS and ConvNeXt-V2 perceptual terms for t < 0.8 t<0.8 , in pMF’s time, where t = 1 t=1 is pure noise), with one layout per image held fixed across the step’s network calls. Training layouts come from the clean image: the dense grid with probability 0.30, otherwise the entropy quadtree at δ ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( 0 , 2 ) \delta\sim\mathcal{U}(0,2) , with random entropy maps for 10 % of those (7 % of all images). A merged token is the mean of its base-patch embeddings plus a zero-initialised mixer, and each coarse scale has a zero-initialised pixel refiner on each output branch ( u u , and v v in training; 4.77M added parameters in all), so training starts from the released model. AdamW ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) (0.9,0.95) without weight decay, learning rate 10 − 5 10^{-5} ( 8 × 8\times on the added modules), 500 warm-up steps then constant, gradient clipping at 20, EMA 0.9995. It trains for 64,000 steps at a global batch of 91 (7 GPUs × \times 13; 52 on 4 GPUs for steps 40,000–58,000), 5.1M images, with the learning rate cooled linearly to zero over the last 8,000. Sampling keeps the released guidance, 7.0 on t ∈ [ 0.2 , 0.7 ] t\in[0.2,0.7] .
paragraphs.zh: pMF-L/16（见附录 B.6）使用 pMF 自身的目标函数进行微调，该目标函数从其代码中移植而来（包括 MeanFlow 恒等式及其前向模式导数、带有目标引导的 x x 预测、辅助 v v 损失，以及当 t < 0.8 时的 LPIPS 和 ConvNeXt-V2 感知项；在 pMF 的时间设定中，t = 1 对应纯噪声），每张图像的一个布局在整个步骤的网络调用中保持固定。训练布局来自干净图像：以 0.30 的概率使用密集网格，否则使用熵四叉树，其中 δ ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( 0 , 2 )，并且其中 10% 的布局（即所有图像的 7%）采用随机熵图。合并后的 token 是其基础块嵌入与一个初始化为零的混合器的均值；每个粗尺度在每条输出分支上都有一个初始化为零的像素精化器（训练时使用 u u 和 v v；所有新增参数总计 4.77M），因此训练从已发布的模型开始。优化器为 AdamW（β1 = 0.9，β2 = 0.95），无权重衰减，学习率为 10⁻⁵（新增模块上使用 8× 该值），前 500 步为预热阶段，之后保持恒定，梯度裁剪阈值为 20，EMA 系数为 0.9995。训练持续 64,000 步，全局批量大小为 91（7 块 GPU × 13；步骤 40,000–58,000 期间使用 4 块 GPU，批量大小为 52），共处理 5.1M 张图像，并在最后 8,000 步中将学习率线性降至零。采样时保留已发布的引导参数，在 t ∈ [0.2, 0.7] 范围内设为 7.0。

paragraphs.en: The released model is the parent as shipped, at its dense grid; the base model is the released weights run at the same budget through our sampler, without training. ToMe merges tokens by bipartite soft matching on the image keys before RoPE, averaged over heads (size-weighted, with proportional attention and the same r r in every block; condition tokens, text or JiT’s in-context class tokens, are never merged). FeatSim makes one similarity merge down to B B tokens early in the network (block 3 on MiniT2I). Both wrap the released weights, keep the sampler on the dense grid, and on MiniT2I write the merged tokens back to the dense grid for the last two blocks. RTI runs its released adapter (40k steps), which exists for MiniT2I-B and MiniT2I-L only. On PixelDiT ours is compared with the base model. Every method of a parent shares the prompts or labels, the noise, the solver, the steps, the guidance and the attention arithmetic.
paragraphs.zh: 已发布的模型是原始模型在密集网格上的原始版本；基础模型则是通过我们的采样器以相同预算运行的已发布权重，且未经训练。 ToMe 在 RoPE 之前基于图像键进行二分软匹配来合并标记，并在各个头之间取平均值（按大小加权，具有比例注意力以及每个块中相同的 r；条件标记、文本或 JiT 的上下文内类标记绝不会被合并）。 FeatSim 在网络早期阶段（MiniT2I 的块 3）将相似性合并至 B 个标记。 两者都封装了已发布的权重，保留了密集网格上的采样器，并且在 MiniT2I 上会将合并后的标记写回密集网格以用于最后两个块。 RTI 运行其已发布的适配器（40k 步），该适配器仅适用于 MiniT2I-B 和 MiniT2I-L。 在 PixelDiT 上，我们的方法与基础模型进行比较。 所有原始模型的方法都共享提示或标签、噪声、求解器、步数、引导机制以及注意力运算。

paragraphs.en: FID and Inception score follow JiT: Inception-v3 from torch-fidelity on uint8 images at native resolution, against JiT’s ImageNet-1k ( Deng et al., 2009 ) training-set statistics at 256 2 256^{2} and 512 2 512^{2} ; the Inception score uses 10 splits. FID-50k uses 50 images per class; the ablations (see App. D ) use FID-10k, 10 per class. Each FID is a single run.
paragraphs.zh: FID 和 Inception 分数遵循 JiT 的方法：使用 torch-fidelity 中的 Inception-v3，在 uint8 图像的原生分辨率上计算，并与 JiT 的 ImageNet-1k（Deng 等人，2009）训练集统计量在 256² 和 512² 分辨率下进行比较；Inception 分数使用 10 个分割。FID-50k 每类使用 50 张图像；消融研究（见附录 D）使用 FID-10k，每类 10 张图像。每个 FID 均为单次运行结果。

paragraphs.en: GenEval (553 prompts, 4 images each) counts an image as correct only if every element of its prompt is rendered, averaged over six tasks; DPG-Bench (1,065 prompts, 4 images each) is the mean mPLUG-large answer; CLIP score (ViT-L/14), PickScore and ImageReward are means over the 1,632 PartiPrompts, one image each. Held-out FID, used at the dense grid, compares 5k generated with 5k held-out real images for CC12M ( Changpinyo et al., 2021 ) and 2k with 2k for PD12M, at native resolution, with 50 steps at guidance 3.0 (MiniT2I-B), 5.0 (MiniT2I-L) and 2.75 (PixelDiT).
paragraphs.zh: GenEval（553个提示，每个提示对应4张图像）仅当提示中的每个元素都被呈现时才将一张图像视为正确，结果基于六个任务的平均值；DPG-Bench（1,065个提示，每个提示对应4张图像）是mPLUG-large模型答案的平均值；CLIP分数（ViT-L/14）、PickScore和ImageReward则是基于1,632个PartiPrompts（每个提示对应1张图像）计算出的平均值。 在密集网格中使用的预留FID指标，通过比较5,000张生成图像与5,000张预留的真实图像来评估CC12M数据集（Changpinyo等人，2021年），并通过比较2,000张生成图像与2,000张真实图像来评估PD12M数据集。测试在原始分辨率下进行，引导系数分别设为3.0（MiniT2I-B）、5.0（MiniT2I-L）和2.75（PixelDiT），迭代步数为50步。

paragraphs.en: The first image is a REFERENCE, generated by this same method at its full token budget from the prompt: “ ⟨ \langle prompt ⟩ \rangle ”
paragraphs.zh: 第一张图像是一个参考图，由同一方法在其完整的令牌预算下，根据提示“⟨ \langle prompt ⟩ \rangle”生成。

paragraphs.en: The second image is a grid of ten images from the same prompt and the same starting noise, generated by the SAME method at decreasing token budgets. paragraphs.zh: 第二张图像是一个由十个来自相同提示和相同初始噪声的图像组成的网格，这些图像由 SAME 方法在不同降低的令牌预算下生成。 每个图块上方都标有相应的预算值，按顺序从 100%（左上角）递减到 10%（右下角）；100% 的图块即为参考图像本身。

sents.en: The second image is a grid of ten images from the same prompt and the same starting noise, generated by the SAME method at decreasing token budgets.
sents.zh: 第二张图像是一个由十个来自相同提示和相同初始噪声的图像组成的网格，这些图像由 SAME 方法在不同降低的令牌预算下生成。

paragraphs.en: Reading the grid in order from 100% downwards, at which budget do you FIRST notice a visible difference from the reference (a change of content, layout, or clearly lost detail)? If even the 10% tile is indistinguishable from the reference, answer 0.

sents.en: Reading the grid in order from 100% downwards, at which budget do you FIRST notice a visible difference from the reference (a change of content, layout, or clearly lost detail)?

paragraphs.en: The judge sees the released image, then ours and one baseline at the same budget, after this text:

paragraphs.en: Every cell was timed on one H100, with the overhead of the measurement rather than of the method removed: per-forward GPU-to-CPU synchronisations, layout work repeated on every forward, and kernel-launch cost, with one CUDA graph per layout. The images are bit-identical to those of each method’s released code; ours and the base model also resample merged tokens with two fp32 matrix products (identical images on MiniT2I, ∼ 55 {\sim}55 dB PSNR on JiT). Speed-up is over the released model at its dense grid, timed the same way. Table 21 lists the conditions, which every method of a parent shares.
paragraphs.zh: 每个单元都在一台 H100 上进行了计时，并排除了测量本身而非方法本身的额外开销：每次前向传播时的 GPU 到 CPU 同步、每次前向传播重复的布局操作以及内核启动成本，其中每个布局对应一个 CUDA 图。 这些图像与每种方法已发布代码生成的图像在比特层面完全一致；我们的模型和基础模型还会通过两次 fp32 矩阵乘法对合并后的标记进行重采样（在 MiniT2I 上图像完全相同，在 JiT 上的 PSNR 约为 55 {\sim}55 dB）。 加速效果是相对于已发布模型在其密集网格配置下的表现而言的，计时方式也保持一致。 表 21 列出了这些条件，同一父类的所有方法都共享这些条件。

sents.en: Every cell was timed on one H100, with the overhead of the measurement rather than of the method removed: per-forward GPU-to-CPU synchronisations, layout work repeated on every forward, and kernel-launch cost, with one CUDA graph per layout.
sents.zh: 每个单元都在一台 H100 上进行了计时，并排除了测量本身而非方法本身的额外开销：每次前向传播时的 GPU 到 CPU 同步、每次前向传播重复的布局操作以及内核启动成本，其中每个布局对应一个 CUDA 图。

sents.en: The images are bit-identical to those of each method’s released code; ours and the base model also resample merged tokens with two fp32 matrix products (identical images on MiniT2I, ∼ 55 {\sim}55 dB PSNR on JiT).
sents.zh: 这些图像与每种方法已发布代码生成的图像在比特层面完全一致；我们的模型和基础模型还会通过两次 fp32 矩阵乘法对合并后的标记进行重采样（在 MiniT2I 上图像完全相同，在 JiT 上的 PSNR 约为 55 {\sim}55 dB）。

sents.en: Speed-up is over the released model at its dense grid, timed the same way.
sents.zh: 加速效果是相对于已发布模型在其密集网格配置下的表现而言的，计时方式也保持一致。

sents.en: Table 21 lists the conditions, which every method of a parent shares.
sents.zh: 表 21 列出了这些条件，同一父类的所有方法都共享这些条件。

paragraphs.en: ToMe, FeatSim and RTI are not deterministic: two runs of their released code agree only to 20, 27 and 34 dB PSNR, so for them the images match up to this noise. PixelDiT does not replay correctly as a CUDA graph (23 dB against its own output), so it is timed without graphs, with bit-identical images.
paragraphs.zh: ToMe、FeatSim 和 RTI 并非确定性的：其发布的代码运行两次后，PSNR 值仅分别一致到 20、27 和 34 dB，因此对于这些模型而言，图像仅在噪声水平上保持一致。 PixelDiT 作为 CUDA 图无法正确重放（与自身输出相比为 23 dB），因此在不使用图的情况下进行计时，此时图像在比特层面完全一致。

paragraphs.en: Each ablation changes one factor at a time on JiT-B, on the development model (see App. D.1 – D.5 ) or on the final JiT-B/32 (see App. D.6 – D.9 ).
